pois.name: Fremantle Markets
pois.intro: The Fremantle Markets is a public market located on the corner of South Terrace and Henderson Street, Fremantle, Western Australia. Built in 1897, it houses over 150 shops for craftspeople, fashion designers, and merchants in the historic Hall, and fresh food producers, vegetable growers and food retailers in The Yard.

pois.name: Western Australian Maritime Museum
pois.intro: The Western Australian Museum is a statutory authority within the Culture and the Arts Portfolio, established under the Museum Act 1969. The museum has six main sites.

pois.name: Bathers Beach
pois.intro: Bathers Beach, also known as Whalers Beach, is a section of coastline that has a written history since the European settlement of what is now called Fremantle, Western Australia. In the 1890s it was bounded to the south by the Long and Short jetties.

pois.name: Fremantle Prison
pois.intro: Fremantle Prison, sometimes referred to as Fremantle Gaol or Fremantle Jail, is a former Australian prison and World Heritage Site in Fremantle, Western Australia. The site includes the prison cellblocks, gatehouse, perimeter walls, cottages, and tunnels.

pois.name: HMAS Ovens
pois.intro: HMAS Ovens is an Oberon-class submarine, formerly of the Royal Australian Navy. She was one of six Oberons built for the Royal Australian Navy by the Scottish Scotts Shipbuilding & Engineering Company, and entered service in 1969.

pois.name: Adventure World
pois.intro: Adventure World is a theme park in Bibra Lake, a suburb of Perth, Western Australia. The park opened on 11 November 1982 as Adventureworld at Bibra Lakes, and is open annually from spring through autumn, for seven months, undergoing a winter closure each year.

pois.name: North Mole Lighthouse
pois.intro: The North Mole Lighthouse began operation in 1906 at the entrance to Fremantle Harbour in Western Australia. The occulting red light, emitted from a fixed light source at a focal plane height of 15 metres above sea level, is visible for 18 kilometres and indicates the westernmost point of the harbour and its entrance.

pois.name: Queens Square
pois.intro: Queens Square, also known as Queen's Square, is a town square in Fremantle, Western Australia. It is located at the intersection of High Street and Parry Street, both of which bisect the square.

pois.name: Fremantle Court House and Police Station Complex
pois.intro: The Old Fremantle Police Station and Court House Complex is a heritage-listed group of buildings located at 45 Henderson Street, Fremantle, Western Australia. The complex includes the former courthouse, police station, police barracks and lock-up and artillery drill hall.

pois.name: The Jetty

Little Creatures
pois.intro: Little Creatures Brewery Pty Ltd is a brewery based in Fremantle, Western Australia, operating as a subsidiary of the Japanese firm Kirin Company. It is owned by Little World Beverages, a wholly owned subsidiary of Lion which is itself a wholly owned subsidiary of Kirin.

pois.name: The Sail and Anchor
pois.intro: The Sail and Anchor is a pub located on the corner of South Terrace and Henderson Street in Fremantle, Western Australia, opposite the Fremantle Markets. It is owned by the Australian Leisure and Hospitality Group.

pois.name: Norfolk Hotel
pois.intro: The Norfolk Hotel is located on the corner of South Terrace and Norfolk Street in Fremantle, Western Australia. The stone built hotel was originally constructed in 1887 before the 1893 Kalgoorlie gold rush for George Alfred Davies, a vintner, local councillor and Mayor of Fremantle.

pois.name: Mojo's Bar
pois.intro: Mojo's Bar, also known colloquially as Mojos, is a live music venue and bar in North Fremantle, Western Australia. It has been described as "a linchpin of Perth's live music scene", and is known as a venue where some notable musicians have performed before their careers launched.

pois.name: Leighton Beach
pois.intro: Leighton Beach är en strand i Australien. Den ligger i kommunen Fremantle och delstaten Western Australia, omkring 13 kilometer sydväst om delstatshuvudstaden Perth.

pois.name: Esplanade Park
pois.intro: Esplanade Park is a public reserve in Fremantle, Western Australia. Situated at the northern end of Marine Terrace opposite the Esplanade Hotel, the reserve features about 100 mature Norfolk Island pines.

pois.name: C. Y. O'Connor Beach
pois.intro: C.Y. O'Connor Beach is a beach in the suburb of North Coogee, south of Fremantle, Western Australia. It extends from McTaggart Cove in the south to Catherine Point in the north and is also known as the CY O'Connor Reserve.

pois.name: Wireless Hill Park
pois.intro: Wireless Hill Park is a 40-hectare park in Ardross, Western Australia that is the location of the former Applecross Wireless Station, an early radio station in Western Australia. The station buildings have been preserved and now house the Wireless Hill Museum.

pois.name: Cottesloe Beach
pois.intro: Cottesloe Beach, known in the Noongar language as Mudurup, is a popular beach in Cottesloe and one of the most iconic locations of Western Australia.

pois.name: Priceline Pharmacy
pois.intro: Priceline is an Australian health and beauty retailer. The Priceline brand has two store types; a traditional Priceline and Priceline Pharmacy.

pois.name: E Shed Markets
pois.intro: E Shed Markets is a weekend market located on Victoria Quay in the Fremantle Harbour in Western Australia. It is housed in a historic timber building known as "E" Shed that was constructed in 1929 further up the quay and closer to the wharf.
